Roman silver TOT finger ring, 20mm in diameter, 21mm wide and 3mm thick (at loop). The object is in good condition and weighs 4.27grams. The ring has a sub rectangular bezel which forms half of its total surface. It consists of a circular raised bezel inscribed with O.
